references.text: Here it is mentioned that the priests break the Sabbath without being guilty, which is relevant to the discussion in Matthew 12:5 about the priests in the temple who break the Sabbath without being considered guilty.

This verse indicates that even on the Sabbath, work was carried out in connection with sacrifices in the temple, supporting the point in Matthew 12:5 that the priests break the Sabbath without being held guilty.
